---
title: Light app log
---

Lines the light apps write to the AppDaemon log. Sun values print as `deg`, for example `sun=-3.0deg`. Where to find the log: [Read the log](../../user-guide/log.qmd).

## A sunrise morning

```
INFO bedroom_sunrise: check: start trigger; daily at 05:45:00
INFO bedroom_sunrise: start: short of from_level; sun=-9.8deg to_level=0deg off_level=12deg
INFO bedroom_sunrise: set: ramp 0%; light.bedroom_lamp 5% sun=-9.8deg transition=5s
INFO bedroom_sunrise: set: ramp 70%; light.bedroom_lamp 31% sun=-3.0deg transition=60s
INFO bedroom_sunrise: set: ramp 100%; light.bedroom_lamp 100% sun=0.0deg transition=60s
INFO bedroom_sunrise: set: dim 50%; light.bedroom_lamp 35% sun=6.0deg transition=60s
INFO bedroom_sunrise: off: reached off_level; light.bedroom_lamp sun=12.0deg off_level=12deg transition=300s
INFO bedroom_sunrise: end: reached off_level; until next start trigger
```

## Lines

| Line | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `load: init` | The app loaded. Lists its settings. |
| `check: start trigger` | A start trigger or the test event fired |
| `start: short of from_level` | The fade starts now |
| `resume: started before restart` | The app restarted during a fade and carries on |
| `set: ramp N%` | The light was set to a brightness. `N%` is how far through the fade the sun is. |
| `set: dim N%` | The light was dimmed. `N%` is how far the sun is from `to_level` to `off_level`. |
| `keep: raised by hand` | The light was turned up while dimming. Left alone until `off_level`. |
| `keep: above target` | The light is already brighter than the fade, usually from a manual change. Left alone. |
| `ramp done: past to_level` | The fade reached full brightness. Not logged with `dim`. |
| `off: reached off_level`, `off: reached off_time` | The light is fading off |
| `end: reached off_level`, `end: reached off_time` | The fade is over until the next start trigger |
| `skip resume: started too long ago` | The app restarted, and the saved fade is too old to carry on |
| `skip resume: unreadable record` | The app restarted, and the saved fade could not be read |
| `skip start: <reason>` | A start trigger or test event fired, and the fade did not start. Reasons below. |
| `skip: <reason>` | A sun update changed nothing. Reasons below. |

## Skip reasons

| Reason | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `past from_level` | The sun has already passed `from_level`. Too late today. |
| `sun rising`, `sun falling` | The sun is moving the other way from the fade |
| `no sun reading` | Home Assistant has no sun elevation. Check the Sun integration. |
| `waiting for start trigger` | The app has start triggers and none has started the fade yet. The `load` line shows when they fire. |
| `short of ramp_from` | The sun has not reached the fade's start yet |
| `past to_level` | The fade is over for today |
| `already off` | Past `off_level` or at `off_time`, and the light is off |
| `at or above target` | The light is already at or above the fade's brightness |
| `at or below target` | While dimming, the light is already at or below the fade's brightness |
| `off` | While dimming, the light is off. Left off. |

`skip` lines from sun updates are hidden at the default log level. They show after a test event, which logs every step. To see them all the time for one app, add `log_level: DEBUG` to its entry in `apps.yaml`.
